constants.note: The New Zealand waste disposal levy at NZD 60 per tonne, as a per-kilogram charge. Non-zero on purpose: a constant bound to zero cannot tell a formula that reads it apart from one that ignores it.

formulas.notes: Three terms, all distinct and none of them a multiple of another, so dropping any one of them changes the answer by a different amount.

upstream.source_note: The row a null food_category must resolve to.

Deliberately absurd, and never read by this case. An engine that resolved a null food_category to the wrong category would produce 2521.25 instead of 26.25 - a difference nobody could mistake for a rounding error.

downstream.source_note: A gate fee, on the generic (food_category: null) row.
